name: grp-mcp-mac
description: Superseded by the grp-mcp plugin, which is cross-platform as of 0.81.0-rc15 and identical to this one; this stays published so existing macOS and Linux installs keep updating. It existed because grp-mcp used to bundle a Windows .exe that a Mac could not execute; both now run the same code through uvx, so the split has no purpose left. Install ONE of the two, never both - they register the same server name. Needs uv: 'brew install uv'. Run the grp-mcp-setup command in this plugin's README once to create your connections file; the server then finds it with no environment variable set. LATEST (0.81.0-rc42): identical to grp-mcp. On a slow site, a customization call that timed out could leave its sign-in open and its API seat taken until the site timed it out, while release_sessions reported nothing to release. The plugin now keeps such a session and goes on signing it out, and the error says the site did not answer where it used to be blank. Full history in docs/CHANGELOG.md.
